name: /refine-backlog
description: Process backlog items: promote to TODO, defer, or delete

steps.context: Read .exocortex/control/BACKLOG.md and .exocortex/TODO.md. Show summary of both. For each backlog item one at a time, ask: (A) Promote to TODO — then ask for executable task title + scope, (B) Not yet — ask what's needed, update backlog notes, (C) Defer — leave as-is, (D) Delete. Also check TODO for completed [x] items, ask to remove each.

steps.action: Apply only the approved ordinary local edits
steps.context: Show the exact proposed diff. Reuse owner approval when it covers these local paths and changes; otherwise ask once. Ordinary TODO, backlog and memory edits need no work-item registration or capability under AI_START_HERE section 3. Preserve unrelated work. Guarded runtime transitions, template updates and external delivery remain separate; never invoke them as bookkeeping for this edit.
